proposals.evidence: Turner gives Assamese xaru “small, fine, younger, inferior” and Bengali/Oriya saru “fine, thin, slender” under saru. These eastern huru/suṛu forms match the whole regional small adjective, with h for the eastern s/x series and source flap notation retained. The link leaves regional contact open; Bishnupriya hurkaŋ has additional material and is not reduced to this stem.
